common.description: AI dispatcher for a small van fleet. MVP deadline: 15 November 2026; later a portfolio project.

apiUnreachable.title: Cannot reach the API at {url}
apiUnreachable.hint: Check that the API is running on port 8000. If it is, the browser may be blocking the request: check CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS.

auth.title: Sign in
auth.subtitle: Use the account your administrator gave you.
auth.headline: Profitable van routes, planned with an AI dispatcher.
auth.lead: Agents search offers and check drivers' time. A deterministic engine builds and verifies every plan. You approve each assignment.

form.captchaHint: Complete the check below to sign in.
form.captchaUnavailable: The check could not be loaded. Reload the page and try again.

validation.emailInvalid: Enter a valid email address, for example name@example.com.

auth.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Wait {seconds} seconds and try again.

localHint.title: Local demo
localHint.body: Accounts: {demo} or {admin}. The passwords are in apps/api/.env.example.

footer.synthetic: All drivers, vans and offers in this app are synthetic demo data.

noAccess.title: No access
noAccess.body: Your role does not include this page.

fleet.title: Fleet
fleet.subtitle: Drivers, vans and remaining working time

empty.driversBody: Add a driver, or generate demo data in Admin.
empty.vehiclesBody: Add a vehicle before you assign it to a driver.

stateForm.title: Add driver state
stateForm.description: The state of {name} as of now.

validation.countryInvalid: Use two capital letters, for example PL.

validation.dimensionPositive: Enter a value above 0 or leave it empty.

conflict.title: This record was changed elsewhere

delete.vehicleBody: The vehicle is removed from the fleet.

legal.notice: The work/driving/rest schedule is a planning estimate based on a simplified model of selected rules (Polish Act on Drivers' Working Time; Regulation (EC) No 561/2006). It does not certify legal compliance.
